subject: Uninstallation RRO caused missing path alias to "R"?

messages.author: cb0312e9c60a7720
messages.subject: Uninstallation RRO caused missing path alias to "R"?
parts:
Uninstallation rro on Ubuntu 14.04 results that "R" letter in bash is not recognized as R console app.
Can you provide the fix for that?

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: Uninstallation RRO caused missing path alias to "R"?
parts:
Uninstalling RRO removes the R shell script it installs. You'll just need to reinstall CRAN R to reinstate it (unless you used the side-by-side install instructions: http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/#revorinst-sidebyside

Cheers,
# David Smith
